consent.title: Electronic signature
consent.text: I agree to use electronic records and signatures for this lease and related notices. I understand my electronic signature has the same legal effect as a handwritten one (Puerto Rico Electronic Transactions Act, Law 148-2006, and the federal ESIGN Act), that I can ask the landlord for a paper copy, and that I can withdraw this consent before signing.
consent.agree: I agree to use an electronic signature

verify.title: Confirm your identity
verify.inPerson: Signing in person: the signer must receive the code on their own phone or email.

sign.title: Sign
sign.typedHint: Your signature will look like this:
sign.intent: I am signing this lease electronically and agree to its terms.

done.title: Done! You signed the lease
done.waiting: We'll email you the signed copy once every party signs.
done.sealed: Everyone signed. We emailed you the signed copy.
done.portal: Create a free account to see your leases and receipts anytime.

decline.title: Decline the lease?
decline.description: We'll let the landlord know. You can tell them why (optional).
decline.declined: You declined to sign this lease. We let the landlord know.

error.title: We can't open this link
error.help: If you think this is a mistake, contact your landlord.
